resources.title: Model Card Template
resources.description: A blank, fillable model card covering the six sections from Lesson 12 — intended use, out-of-scope use, training data, evaluation, known limitations, and owner/review date — plus risk tier and approval-record fields that tie it to Lessons 13, 16, and 24. A filled-in example built from this exact template is in the Worked Example Library.

resources.title: AI Risk Tiering Worksheet
resources.description: A CSV worksheet for scoring any AI system's likelihood and impact as high/medium/low and recording the resulting risk tier with a one-line justification — the exact method from Lesson 24, pre-filled with two worked examples so the scoring pattern is clear before you add your own systems.

resources.title: AI System Inventory & Registry Tracker
resources.description: A CSV tracker capturing the fields a governance-ready registry entry needs beyond a file path and version number — owner, risk tier, model card link, registry status, and current production version — from Lesson 13, pre-filled with two worked examples.

resources.title: AI Incident Response Runbook
resources.description: A fillable runbook built directly on Lesson 22's five-step response sequence (detect, contain, assess impact via lineage, notify, remediate), with an alias-rollback section and an after-containment checklist tying back into model cards, approval workflows, and audits. A completed example run against Brightfield Outfitters' chatbot incident is in the Worked Example Library.

resources.title: AI Audit Evidence Checklist
resources.description: The six pieces of evidence a real AI audit should be able to produce for any in-scope system, from Lesson 27, laid out as a request-before-you-begin checklist with a findings-and-remediation table — so a missing item becomes a dated finding, not an assumption.
